t: To get Nori Sheets you will need to find some Kelp in the oceans and make a Dried Kelp Block with it. $(br2)Squishing a Dried Kelp Block (dropped as an item) between an Iron Block with a piston will get you some Nori Sheets.
要获得海苔片，你需要先在海洋中寻找海带，并用其制作干海带块。$(br2)将干海带块（以物品形式掉落）置于铁块与活塞之间进行挤压，即可获得海苔片。
